//: Arenas (Phase 5): where the court stands, how it is lit and what is round it. Looks were matched to the reference photos in reference/photos.json with the photo-match mode (?photo=<id>); DECISIONS.md (Phase 5) has what each number came from. Colours are sRGB hex; light intensities are three.js units (directional/hemisphere: lux-like scale with AgX tone mapping at `exposure`).

stadium.name: Arena (indoor, TV)
stadium.//kind: Pro events are played in sports halls and arenas: tiered stands on four sides, a coloured surround, boards, a high lit roof (arena-wide, arena-wide-2, arena-glass).
stadium.//floor: Tournament courts are blue sand-filled turf; little sand shows on a new tournament carpet. Blue matched under the arena's light against arena-wide-2.
stadium.//surround: Red turf round the glass out to about 4.5 m at the sides and 6.5 m at the ends (arena-wide-2), then the hall floor.
stadium.//base: The light grey steel the glass panels stand on, visible as a pale line round the court in every panoramic reference.
stadium.//light: The roof's skylights and the event floodlights: bright, nearly shadowless from above (soft, faint shadows under the players in arena-wide-2). The key light gives the soft shadow; the reflections and most of the fill come from the arena itself (environment map rendered from the court).

hall.name: Club hall (covered)
hall.//kind: A covered club: a steel shed over two courts, open or half-open sides, daylight from the sides and the roof (hall, hall-2).
hall.//neighbours: Covered clubs put two or more courts side by side under one roof, about 2.5 m apart (hall, hall-2).

club-day.name: Club (outdoor, day)
club-day.//kind: An outdoor club court in a park: grass and paths round it, trees, a neighbour's fence, floodlight poles on the side mesh (day-framed, day-panoramic, day-hyde, day-lights).
club-day.//neighbours: Clubs build courts in rows, side by side about 2.5 m apart (night, day-panoramic, Club Kingswood).

club-night.name: Club (outdoor, night)
club-night.//kind: The same club at night under its floodlights: LED heads on 6-7 m poles at the ends of the side mesh, a dark sky, pools of light on the court and darkness beyond (night).
club-night.//neighbours: Clubs build courts in rows, side by side about 2.5 m apart (night, day-panoramic, Club Kingswood).
club-night.//floods: Eight heads (two per pole, four poles); spot lights aimed at the court. Only one casts a shadow (cost); the others light without.
